name: showcase
_doc: Cut list for the showcase - the EDIT half of scenarios/shots/showcase.json (the SHOOT half).
Assemble with scripts/rig/assemble.py. One segment per row of the shot list (the Row N of
its notes), in story order; the arena montage (row 5a) is one segment per arena take.
EVERY in/out BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER: set after per-frame measurement (motion_probe.py) of the
real take, with the reason in the segment's note. assemble.py needs numbers (in >= 0, out >
in, out <= the probed take length), so each placeholder is in=0 and out = the planned
on-screen length x the segment's speed; the cut's total is therefore the planned
~97 s. A take has ~3.5 s of warm-up before the action - in=0 is never the right number.
Speeds (vein 3, smelt 4, finale 20) are planning values too; a caption's rate comes from
{speed}, so re-timing a speed re-labels it.
CONSOLE CARDS (card_prospect, card_gate) are not game takes: scripts/rig/console_card.py
renders them from scenarios/shots/cards/*.json into this takes_dir at this cut's size and
fps. The prospect card's numbers are <FILL:...> tokens copied from 01a's during.log - the
render refuses an unfilled token. The gate card prints the all-PASS summary literally and is
rendered only from a full `just gate-live --port 55545` run whose summary line reads exactly
the card's last line.
CAPTIONS: EN, burned in by assemble.py. The top-left `label` carries the act counter
(N/6) through the act; a cue cannot span segments, so each segment repeats its act's
label (it re-fades at the cut). The arena labels claim PASS: each names a gated arena
(scripts/dev/gate_live.py, asserting expect.events) and is true only for a take whose
during.log shows that arena's PASS. The montage first planned water-dive, parkour-gap2 and
bridge-engine, but those are build-only fixtures the gate never runs, so they carry no PASS
to film; drill-gap-vein (it bridges a void), goto-travel, mine-vein, chop-tree and
restock-craft stand in. The prospect line names no distance: the measured one is on card 1b, copied from
01a's real response. The finale credit is teaser_cut.json's, verbatim.

segments.note: Row 0. PLACEHOLDER in/out (6 s planned). Want: the worn stone pickaxe's durability bar readable, then the swap to the prospector at the very end.
Row 1a. PLACEHOLDER in/out (8 s planned). Want: the GUI opening and the vein map filling in (the scan settles over ~1 s).
Row 1b. Console card rendered by console_card.py from scenarios/shots/cards/1b_prospect.json (3.0 s long by spec, so 0-3 is its whole length).
Row 2a. PLACEHOLDER in/out (11 s planned). Want: the raised step, the sprint-boost leap (the teaser's poster frame is mid-air ~5 s into the action), the landing on platform B.

Row 2b. PLACEHOLDER in/out (12 s planned). The splash lives ~3 ticks: measure it with motion_probe.py --preset static-hook (docs/RIG.md § Static hook shots). Slow-mo (speed 0.5) is untested in assemble.py - try it on this segment alone first.
Row 3a. PLACEHOLDER in/out (10 s planned). Want: the look snapping to straight down and the shaft walls sliding past.
Row 3b. PLACEHOLDER in/out (10 s planned at 3x = 30 s of take). The teaser's 03_vein measured live from 6.0 s; expect a similar warm-up.
Row 4a. PLACEHOLDER in/out (4 s planned). Want: chamber -> teleport -> the base, with the cut landing on the base.
Row 4b. PLACEHOLDER in/out (8 s planned at 4x = 32 s of take: load, ~10 s per ingot, collect).
Row 4c. PLACEHOLDER in/out (8 s planned). Want: the grid filling, the iron pickaxe in the output slot, the hotbar switching to it.
Row 5a, montage 1/5. PLACEHOLDER in/out (2.0 s planned - it also carries the act's line). Pick the bridge placed over the void. Only a take whose during.log reads PASS drill-gap-vein.
Row 5a, montage 2/5. PLACEHOLDER in/out (1.75 s planned). Only a take whose during.log reads PASS goto-travel.
Row 5a, montage 3/5. PLACEHOLDER in/out (1.75 s planned). Only a take whose during.log reads PASS mine-vein.
Row 5a, montage 4/5. PLACEHOLDER in/out (1.75 s planned). Only a take whose during.log reads PASS chop-tree.
Row 5a, montage 5/5. PLACEHOLDER in/out (1.75 s planned). Only a take whose during.log reads PASS restock-craft.
Row 5b. Console card rendered by console_card.py from scenarios/shots/cards/5b_gate.json (3.0 s long by spec). No captions: the card's own text carries the beat.
Row 5c. PLACEHOLDER in/out (5 s planned at 20x = 100 s of take). The teaser's take of this pose needed in >= 1.0 (unrendered chunk void in the corner before that).
